paragraphs.zh: Schritt 7: 2-Chlor-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoesäure 1.0 g (2.93 mmol) Methyl 3-brommethyl-2-chlor-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoat wurde in 10 ml Cyclohexanol gelöst und mit 0.33 g (2.93 mmol) Kalium-tert-butylat versetzt. Man ließ über Nacht bei Raumtemperatur rühren und engte anschließend am Rotationsverdampfer ein. Der Rückstand wurde in 16 ml Tetrahydrofuran und 8 ml Wasser gelöst und zusammen mit 0.55 g NaOH (13.74 mmol) 4 h unter Rückfluß gekocht. Anschließend ließ man abkühlen, engte am Rotationsverdampfer weitgehend ein und versetzte anschließend den wässrigen Rückstand mit 2 M HCl. Anschließend wurde mit Methylenchlorid extrahiert, die vereinigte organische Phase über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt. Ausbeute: 0.53 g (52 % der Theorie), farbloses Öl 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 0.9 (m,6H), 1,3 (m,4 H), 3.3 (s,3H), 4.75 (m,1H), 5.3 (s,2H), 7.9 (d,1H), 8.1 (d,1H)
paragraphs.en: Step 7: 2-chloro-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid 1.0 g (2.93 mmol) of methyl 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoate was dissolved in 10 ml of cyclohexanol and 0.33 g (2.93 mmol) of potassium tert-butoxide was added. The mixture was left to stir overnight at room temperature and was then concentrated on a rotary evaporator. The residue was dissolved in 16 ml of tetrahydrofuran and 8 ml of water and boiled under reflux for 4 h together with 0.55 g of NaOH (13.74 mmol). It was then allowed to cool, largely concentrated on a rotary evaporator, and the aqueous residue was then treated with 2 M HCl. It was then extracted with methylene chloride, the combined organic phase was dried over MgSO4 and concentrated to dryness on a rotary evaporator. Yield: 0.53 g (52 % of theory), colourless oil 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 0.9 (m,6H), 1,3 (m,4 H), 3.3 (s,3H), 4.75 (m,1H), 5.3 (s,2H), 7.9 (d,1H), 8.1 (d,1H)
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication of PCT/EP99/06627 and not Chinese. In the printed line the leading 1 of '1H NMR' is a superscript, the 3 of CDCl3 is a subscript and the 4 of MgSO4 is a subscript; all are transcribed inline because the field is plain text. The second NMR shift is printed '1,3 (m,4 H)' with a comma decimal separator and a space before the H, while every other shift on the page uses a full stop and no space; transcribed as printed. 'cyclohexanyloxymethyl' in the heading is printed exactly so; the substituent is a cyclohexyloxy group made from cyclohexanol, but the patent's own spelling is kept and carried into the English rather than normalised. The double spaces after 'Ausbeute:', after 'Theorie),' and after 'δ' are as printed. '1.0 g ... wurde' uses a singular verb where the other steps use 'wurden'; transcribed as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Schritt 8: 3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chlor-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoat 0.53 g (1.53 mmol) 2-Chlor-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoesäure wurden in 23 ml Methylenchlorid mit 2 Tropfen N,N-Dimethylformamid und 0.59 g (4.58 mmol) Oxalylchlorid versetzt und 2.5 h unter Rückfluß gekocht. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer abgezogen, der Rückstand in 23 ml Methylenchlorid aufgenommen und bei 0 °C mit 0.19 g (1.68 mmol) Cyclohexandion und 0.46 g (4.58 mmol) Triethylamin versetzt. Man ließ 4 h bei Raumtemperatur nachrühren. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer eingeengt und chromatographisch gereinigt (Kieselgel, Essigester:Hexan = 1:1). Ausbeute: 0.1 g (15 % der Theorie), farbloses Öl 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 0.9 (m,6H), 1.3 (m,4H), 2.35 (m,2H), 2.5 (m,2H), 2.7 (m,2H), 3.35 (s,3H), 5.4 (s,br, 2H), 6.1 (s,1H), 7.95 (d,2H), 8.2 (d,2H)
paragraphs.en: Step 8: 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoate 0.53 g (1.53 mmol) of 2-chloro-3-cyclohexanyloxymethyl-4-methylsulfonyl-benzoic acid in 23 ml of methylene chloride were treated with 2 drops of N,N-dimethylformamide and 0.59 g (4.58 mmol) of oxalyl chloride and boiled under reflux for 2.5 h. The mixture was then stripped on a rotary evaporator, the residue taken up in 23 ml of methylene chloride and treated at 0 °C with 0.19 g (1.68 mmol) of cyclohexanedione and 0.46 g (4.58 mmol) of triethylamine. The mixture was left to stir for a further 4 h at room temperature. It was then concentrated on a rotary evaporator and purified chromatographically (silica gel, ethyl acetate:hexane = 1:1). Yield: 0.1 g (15 % of theory), colourless oil 1H NMR (CDCl3): δ 0.9 (m,6H), 1.3 (m,4H), 2.35 (m,2H), 2.5 (m,2H), 2.7 (m,2H), 3.35 (s,3H), 5.4 (s,br, 2H), 6.1 (s,1H), 7.95 (d,2H), 8.2 (d,2H)
paragraphs.notes: Last block on the page; the page ends after the NMR line with roughly a third of the page left blank. The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication of PCT/EP99/06627 and not Chinese. The heading is set over two printed lines, breaking after '-4-' and continuing with 'methylsulfonyl-benzoat' indented to the level of the first line's compound name; joined here into one line. In the printed line the leading 1 of '1H NMR' is a superscript and the 3 of CDCl3 is a subscript; both are transcribed inline because the field is plain text. 'Cyclohexandion' is printed without a locant, so which cyclohexanedione isomer is meant is not determined by this page; translated literally rather than resolved. The two aromatic signals are printed '7.95 (d,2H)' and '8.2 (d,2H)', that is 2H each, where the same two aromatic protons of the Schritt 7 acid are given as 1H each; recorded as printed and not reconciled. 'Essigester' is the German trivial name for ethyl acetate. The double space after 'Ausbeute:' is as printed.
